Maya K: Quick share — condensed go-live prefill + streaming readiness checklist for CS/Field. Short, actionable items only.
Tom S: Nice. Can we add renewal-risk triggers so AEs know who to call during ramp?
Priya R: Yep — I pasted a compact prefill flow and smoke tests below. Keep these as runbook snippets AEs can copy.
Priya R: Prefill & warmup order (short):
1) Run tenant prefetch job for top N prompts
2) Warm shared KV cache and model warm pools
3) Start reserved warm instances (burst if expected concurrency > threshold)
4) Run streaming smoke tests (both full stream + chunked)
Priya R: Example prefill POST (ops use):
```bash
# Warm cache for tenant 'acme' (run from infra host)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tenant":"acme","prompts":["welcome","init context"],"prefill_size":100}'
```
Elena C: Streaming smoke test (client-facing quick check):
```bash
# small streaming test to validate chunking + SSE behavior
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-lite" \n  -d '{"input":"hi","max_tokens":32}'
```
Tom S: Client retry guidance: exponential backoff + full jitter, max 3 retries, escalate to async queueing if >30s aggregate latency or persistent 503/504.
Tom S: Suggested policy snippet for front-end SDK: `retryCount=3, baseMs=250, maxMs=30000, jitter=true`
CS Bot: Reminder: attach the one-pager checklist and survey link when you run go-live: https://forms.redwood.example/go-live-feedback :memo:
Maya K: Renewal-risk signals to flag for AE: sudden spike in 4xx/5xx, >20% drop in completion rate, repeated 429s during first 72h, and negative trial NPS. Tag accounts `renewal-risk` and schedule a 15-min check-in.
Priya R: AE enablement cadence (short): 30-min prelaunch walkthrough, shared runbook link, ops shadow during first 2 hours, post-launch 1:1 + collect feedback via form.
Elena C: Quick debug CLI for warm-pool/cache health:
```bash
# check tenant warm pool and cache stats
redwoodctl tenant status --tenant acme --fields warm_pool,cache_hits,active_streams
```
Tom S: Ops note: if warm_pool < 70% expected capacity, auto-scale burst nodes + send AE ping. Also enable transient fallback to smaller model for non-critical paths.
Maya K: Capture feedback items we want on the form: latency, error patterns, streaming glitches (missing chunks), perceived quality drop after quantization, and overall onboarding clarity.
Priya R: I'll turn this into a one-pager and add 2 quick paste-ready snippets for AEs. Can someone volunteer to run the first smoke test during Acme go-live?
Elena C: I can take the 10:00 PT slot.
Tom S: I'll monitor metrics and set up the alert rules (4xx/5xx/429 thresholds).
Maya K: Awesome. TL;DR for runbook commit: prefill -> warm pools -> smoke stream -> client retry/backoff -> AE enablement + feedback capture. Posting final one-pager by EOD. :rocket:
